summary: Jumia Technologies AG filed a Form 6-K on May 18, 2026, furnishing the voting results of its annual shareholders meeting held on May 15, 2026. The filing reports the outcome of routine agenda items, including ratification of board acts, appointment of auditors, approval of compensation reports and remuneration systems, election of supervisory board members (with one candidate, Blaise Judja-Sato, being rejected), and amendments to the articles of association regarding electronic shares and authorized capital. No special-situation event such as M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, go-private, spin-off, or restructuring is disclosed. This is a standard periodic report of annual meeting results, not a special situation.
